run_curses_checklist: run a curses multi-select checklist that returns a set of selected item indices
run_curses_radiolist: run a curses single-select radio list that returns the selected item index
run_curses_single_select: run a curses single-select menu that returns the selected index or None on cancel
run_flush_stdin: run a terminal stdin buffer flush to prevent stray bytes from corrupting subsequent input calls
run_numbered_fallback: run a text-based numbered toggle fallback for multi-select when curses is unavailable
